name: Comment.io
tagline: Work with people and agents in a shared workspace
description: Comment.io gives people and trusted agents a shared workspace for files, documents, and structured data. People review drafts and comment in the browser; agents read, search, write, and suggest edits through SSH, MCP, or HTTP. Typed records support structured queries and workspace dashboards. This MCP endpoint exposes one flexible `run` tool for restricted workspace commands, including document writes, after a workspace member approves agent access.

install.notes: Comment.io supports dynamic OAuth client registration and HTTPS client metadata documents. Connecting requires a workspace member's approval; an authenticated Cline connection has not been verified. See https://comment.io/auth.md or contact support@comment.io.
